3. Presentation

10 min
NEW WORD: nostalgicDialogue · Old phone, old memories

Mila is 19 and studies IT. She finds her dad's first mobile phone in a drawer. Read the dialogue.

Mila: Dad, what's this? Is it a phone or a calculator?

Dad: Ha! That's my first mobile phone. I used to take it everywhere.

Mila: It hasn't even got a camera! Did you use to send photos to your friends?

Dad: No, we didn't use to send photos. We used to send short texts, and every text cost money.

Mila: So how did you meet your friends?

Dad: We used to call each other on the home phone and meet outside the cinema. Nobody used to look at screens all evening. We actually talked!

Mila: Sounds nice… but I can't live without Wi-Fi.

Dad: I know. Life was slower then, but I miss it sometimes.

1Which adjective best describes Dad's attitude? nostalgic = feeling happy and a little sad when you remember the past. New word for our tone list!
2How did teenagers use to meet their friends?
3Find 6 examples of used to in the dialogue. Which one is a question? Which one is negative?
Form
+I used to take it everywhere.
−We didn't use to send photos.
?Did you use to send photos?
used to + V1 (infinitive): used to play, used to be, used to have

❌ I didn't used to play.   ✅ I didn't use to play.
❌ Did you used to…?   ✅ Did you use to…?

MEANING
Things that happened regularly in the past, or were true in the past, but are not true now.
Habits: I used to play volleyball every week.
States: I used to have long hair.
LOOK OUT! One action at one time → past simple, not used to.
✅ I went to Kazan last summer.
❌ I used to go to Kazan last summer.
Check you understand

“Dad used to take his phone everywhere.”

“I didn't use to like coffee.”
